dct_description_sm: # China Earthquake: Damage Proxy Maps, Dec 2023 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps for China Earthquake (Dec 2023) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Gansu, China, Earthquake, 26 Dec 2023, v0.9** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Gansu, China, Earthquake, 26 Dec 2023, v0.9** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2023)
